standard_prerequisites.name: Induction on the natural numbers for a type family
standard_prerequisites.statement: A family over the natural numbers has a section as soon as it has an element over zero and a step over successors.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the induction that proves the pointwise equality of the two functions.

standard_prerequisites.name: Application preserves equality
standard_prerequisites.statement: Equal elements of the domain of a function have equal images, and a function applied to equal successors gives equal results.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is what lets the inductive hypothesis be inserted inside the recurrence step.

standard_prerequisites.name: Function extensionality
standard_prerequisites.statement: Two functions are equal as soon as they agree on every argument.
standard_prerequisites.use: It turns the pointwise equality obtained by induction into the equality of the two functions claimed by the statement.

core_obligations: Choose the family over the natural numbers whose value at an element is the identity type between the two functions there, and prove the base case by chaining the two hypotheses at zero (source lines 127-128).

Prove the inductive step: the two recurrence hypotheses identify the images of the successor with the same expression in the values at the element, and the inductive hypothesis makes those values equal, so the images are equal (source lines 129-131).
Conclude pointwise equality and apply function extensionality to obtain the equality of the two functions (source line 131).

proof_roadmap.step: Induction on the family of identity types; base case from the two zero hypotheses.
Inductive step through the recurrence and the inductive hypothesis, then function extensionality.

difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author labelled theorem at source lines 103-124: two functions on the natural numbers that satisfy the same recurrences up to propositional equality are equal. The proof (source lines 126-132) is short but it is the complete argument: it selects the right family of identity types, closes the base case by chaining the two hypotheses at zero, and in the inductive step inserts the inductive hypothesis inside the recurrence step by preservation of equality, finally upgrading the pointwise statement by function extensionality. Choosing the family and making the inductive step go through is the substance, and the statement alone shows none of it.
